component.name: Fodder
component.summary: Lightweight RSS, Atom and JSON feed reader

description.p: Fodder is a lightweight RSS/Atom/JSON-Feed reader for Linux desktops. A resident background service polls your feeds, shows desktop notifications for new articles, and lives in the system tray; a fast three-pane reader opens on demand and frees its memory when closed.

ul.li: RSS, Atom and JSON Feed support with automatic feed discovery
Efficient conditional polling that respects ETag and Last-Modified
Desktop notifications for new articles and an optional daily reading reminder
A clean, distraction-free built-in reader plus an optional full web view
Per-feed unread counts and mark-as-read on open

screenshot.caption: The three-pane reader showing feeds, articles and the reader pane
